title: Avemary

inlines.v: A'VEMARY, noun [from the first words of Gabriel's salutation to the Virgin Mary; Latin ave, hail.] A form of devotion in the Romish Church. Their chaplets and rosaries are divided into a certain number of ave-marys and paternosters.
